claim: ADR 0295 rules 1-2 (AW17, founder 2026-10-04, "Net sales (Recommended)"; F1 "Count and say (Recommended)"): the till window and the avg_check goal metric in goals.service.ts select pos_checks.subtotal and no longer total, and fold through analytics/net-sales.ts foldNetSales, whose one-check read is the subtotal only and which is null (not 0) when checks exist and none carried one. The select may gain cap's 'id, ' prefix (ADR 0292) and still holds.
verify: grep -qF 'from "./net-sales"' apps/api-gateway/src/analytics/goals.service.ts && grep -qE '"(id, )?subtotal, opened_at, closed_at' apps/api-gateway/src/analytics/goals.service.ts && ! grep -qE '"(id, )?total, opened_at' apps/api-gateway/src/analytics/goals.service.ts && grep -qF 'foldNetSales(checks)' apps/api-gateway/src/analytics/goals.service.ts && grep -qF 'const v = check?.subtotal;' apps/api-gateway/src/analytics/net-sales.ts && grep -qF 'netSales: count > 0 && netChecks === 0 ? null : sum,' apps/api-gateway/src/analytics/net-sales.ts

claim: ADR 0295 rules 3-4 (A-019, A-047): the table, server and hot-table registers read covers and subtotal, not total, and the tip rate divides tips by the net of the checks that recorded a tip (netWithTip), never by the gross total (the old totalWithTip is gone).
